chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Jiabi narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Sulaiman ibn Ziyad al-Maruzi, from Ubaidullah ibn Muhammad al-Ayshi, from Hammad ibn Salemah, from Ayyub, from Abu Qalabah, from Abu Hurairah, who said:

The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: The month of Ramadan is a blessed month in which Allah has made its fasting obligatory. In it, the gates of Paradise are opened and the devils are shackled. In it there is a night better than a thousand months; whoever is deprived of it is truly deprived. He repeated this three times.

key_terms.لَيْلَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ: A night better than a thousand months: Laylat al-Qadr

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the blessings of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This prophetic hadith extols the virtues of Ramadan. The Prophet describes it as a blessed month with obligatory fasting, opened gates of Paradise, shackled devils, and Laylat al-Qadr which is better than a thousand months.
